mechanism: Both drugs possess anticholinergic properties and CNS depression effects; oxybutynin may inhibit risperidone metabolism via CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing risperidone levels.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, constipation, dry mouth), CNS depression, and extrapyramidal symptoms; consider dose adjustment if adverse effects emerge.
